description: Variance Hero gives you the possibility to compare deviations of different figures (e.g. actual figures, previous year's figures, plan figures, forecast figures) at a glance over time. In addition, you have the option of displaying values and comments dynamically and interactively as tooltips, which can be activated by mouseover. The special feature of Variance Hero is that the variances can be integrated or displayed separately. If the deviations are displayed separately, it is also possible to switch between absolute and relative deviation with a single click. Only Variance Hero also offers the possibility to switch between the display of variances compared to the previous year, budget and forecast by clicking in the visual. The standard formatting of the chart complies with the International Business Communication Standards (IBCS). However, in terms of formatting, you also have a wide range of customization options to design the desired visualizations according to your ideas and corporate identity. Variance Hero enables effortless and understandable visualization and analysis of figures and variances over time.
